doc.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Hearing himself on the radio
summary: The thrill of hearing his records on the car radio; earlier recordings in New Orleans with his brother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Was there a time when you were driving in your car — did you have a car?
Yeah I had a car. You can’t survive in L.A. without a car.
Okay. Was there a time when you were driving and that song came on the radio that you heard yourself for the first time.
Oh yes. That’s always a thrill yes.

And my brother and I had recorded in New Orleans but we did our own thing and I played behind a couple of artists there too. But hadn’t gotten to any serious recording for a living until I got to L.A. and had been there about a year and a half.
